Tracking Trump’s performance since January shows that Utahns’ approval and disapproval has flip-flopped. Earlier in the year, Utahns were more likely to approve of the president’s performance. In recent months, that’s no longer true.

Approval is something that Trump clearly wants from the American people. He’s posted figures online saying he had a 59% approval rating but no source to back that number up. [...] 00:00/00:00

results.content:
Gov. Mikie Sherrill is among the nation’s most popular governors, while President Donald Trump remains deeply unpopular in New Jersey and both of the state’s Democratic U.S. senators hold solid approval ratings, according to a new Morning Consult poll.

Sherrill has a 55%-30% approval rating, giving her a net approval of +25 during her first quarter in Morning Consult’s gubernatorial tracking. [...] The rankings are based on net approval — the percentage approving minus the percentage disapproving — among registered voters surveyed from April 1 through June 30.
